profile.headline: SDE at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: I’ve spent 8 years working as a software engineer. The time was split working at Capital One and AWS. Across those years, I worked as a Full stack engineer with a strong interest in backend work. I’m experience in cloud architecture and GO/Python/JS. Over the last 8 months, a good focus has been on developing agents that streamlines work for engineers and simplifies the operational burden across my team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Cloud Computing · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Bedrock · AWS Lambda · AWS Step Functions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed two UI projects (in React and Angular), one for helping Small Business open accounts digitally and the other to submit CTRs to FinCEN
• Experienced in working with Java, JS and Spring Boot for backend services for the applications
• Worked with AWS services including EC2, ECS, Lambda and S3
• Managed my team cyber security by organizing, prioritizing and resolving vulnerabilities found in our repositories

positions.title: Finance and Accounting Intern
positions.description:
• Built financial reports using corporate payrolls, credit card statements and ShowBiz databases for the NYS Film Tax Credit Program; increased reimbursement for credit production costs by 30% 
• Analyzed and prepared production budgets by adjusting accounts payable, credit card transactions, electronic wire transfers and petty cash payments onto QuickBooks for over 120 film projects 
• Drafted and developed comprehensive wrap books for senior management to ensure accurate maintenance of cast and crew expenses, vendor invoices and project storyboards
• Minimized expenses by reconciling over $9,000 in duplicate, miscellaneous and erroneous charges listed on the project cost reports

positions.title: Presentation & Technology Associate
positions.description:
• Composed detailed reports of room availability, email invoices of AV equipment and furniture fees and room reservations for over 30 corporate employers in NYU’s Manhattan and Brooklyn campuses
• Communicated with employer partners on a daily basis to maintain and track a database of inbound requests; responsible for  responding to inquiries and finalizing room reservations
• Drafted marketing materials including flyers, presentation boards and internal documents for corporate events; increased student attendance by 15%
• Prepared rooms with PowerPoint presentations, microphones, projectors and other IT equipment to ensure corporate partners can host networking events, hold information sessions and interview candidates effectively

company.name: NYU Wasserman Center for Career Development

honors.title: NYU Dean's Honor List
honors.issuer: Issued by New York University · Aug 2014

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Neighborhood Charter School of Harlem
volunteerExperiences.description: On Tuesday mornings, I taught autistic kindergarten students math concepts, reading techniques and writing skills. I helped them understand and recognize patterns and read challenging books. On Friday afternoons, I tutored 1st and 2nd graders in Math and Language Arts.

company.name: The Neighborhood Charter School of Harlem

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Delta - Theta Beta Chapter
organizations.position: Co-Philanthropy Chair and Secretary · Nov 2014 - May 2015
organizations.description:
• Led weekly meetings to discuss community service events; raised over $1000 at NYU's Annual Relay for Life
• Planned, advertised and executed the chapter's annual Food  Drive; collected over 1000 cans of food and raised over $3000 for the Bowery Mission Homeless Shelter
• Spearheaded the development of the chapter's Rush Events schedule, organizing over 10 events with a $400 budget
